canonical_project: Lumina CloudInfra Chandivali data centre (60 MW)
notes: Blackstone-backed Lumina CloudInfra acquired about 3.8 acres in Chandivali, Andheri East (Mumbai Suburban district) for Rs 475 crore (reported Aug 2025) to develop a 60 MW hyperscale data centre as two 30 MW units; land acquired, construction not yet reported. Blackstone also builds separate 60 MW Navi Mumbai (Ghansoli) facilities and a 500 MW campus (other districts).
